asks: Does the model answer the question, and both one-hop questions, right?
what_happened: Two-hop: says “Two” (right answer “Two”, P = 0.95). Hop 1 “Which vehicle do you ride by pedalling? Answer in one word.” → “Bicycle”. Hop 2 “How many wheels does a bicycle have? Answer in one word.” → “Two”.

asks: Is every edited word a single token?
Does removing the answer's own direction kill it, and from which layers?
what_happened: Remove the answer “Two” itself: first kills it in layers 21–26 (P 0.95 → 0.29, drop 0.70). That's where the model starts writing the answer.

asks: Same question, asked to name the bridge first: does removing the bridge (before the answer onset) kill its name?
what_happened: Ask “How many wheels does the vehicle that you ride by pedalling have? Answer in one word. First name the vehicle.” with the reply starting “The vehicle is” (model continues: “a bicycle, and it has”). Remove “bicycle” in layers 9–14 → P(“bicycle”) goes 0.90 → 0.82. Drop 0.09.

asks: Does removing the bridge, before the answer onset, kill the answer?
what_happened: Remove “bicycle” in layers 15–20 → P(“Two”) goes 0.95 → 0.65. Drop 0.32.

asks: Is that drop bigger than removing everyday words of the same strength?
what_happened: Biggest drop from 12 everyday words: 0.02 (“saddle”, layers 12–17). Bridge 0.32 − noise 0.02 = 0.30 (pass ≥ 0.5).

asks: Does the bridge start to matter at least 3 layers before the answer does?
what_happened: “bicycle” first matters from layer 18; the answer “Two” from layer 21 → 3 layers earlier.

asks: Does removing the bridge matter more than removing another word of its kind with the same answer?
what_happened: Remove “bus” (same answer) → P(“Two”) goes 0.95 → 0.91. Drop 0.05. Bridge 0.32 − 0.05 = 0.27 (pass ≥ 0.3).

asks: Does the same edit leave unrelated questions alone?
what_happened: Same edit (layers 15–20): “What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer in one word.” → P(“Au”) 1.00 → 1.00; “What is the largest planet in the Solar System? Answer in one word.” → P(“Jupiter”) 0.95 → 0.95. Biggest drop 0.00 (pass ≤ 0.1).

asks: What if the bridge is removed over many layers at once?
what_happened: Remove “bicycle” in layers 8–23 → P(“Two”) 0.95 → 0.18 (drop 0.81); in all layers → 0.22 (drop 0.77).

asks: Does removing only the part of the bridge not shared with the answer still kill it?
Swap in another word: does the answer become that word's answer?
what_happened: 0 of 2 swaps gave the swapped word's own answer (fallback answer with the bridge removed: “2”).

asks: Swap in a word with the same answer: is the answer kept?
Need × specificity × isolation (0 if the bridge doesn't come first)
what_happened: Need 0.30 (drop beyond noise) × specificity 0.85 (share not matched by a same-kind word) × isolation 1.00 (share left when the part shared with the answer is kept) = 0.25.
